hooks.name: SeamTrail: chat start
hooks.description: Registers this chat with SeamTrail and hands the agent the project's context, or the question which SeamTrail project the chat is for.

hooks.name: SeamTrail: at each message
hooks.description: Hands the agent what is new on the chat's work and the latest memory about the tickets the message names. Sends only the chat id and the ticket keys, never the message.

hooks.name: SeamTrail: note saved
hooks.description: Marks the turn saved after remember, resolve, settle_question or widen_memory. Nothing leaves the computer.

hooks.name: SeamTrail: change made
hooks.description: Marks the turn saved when ask_seamtrail or undo_change really changed something. Nothing leaves the computer.

hooks.name: SeamTrail: project picked
hooks.description: Keeps the SeamTrail project picked for this chat, for the save reminder. Nothing leaves the computer.

hooks.name: SeamTrail: turn end
hooks.description: When nothing was saved to SeamTrail this turn, notes it on this computer, so the agent is reminded once with the next message. It never stops the agent.
